name: Norway: Part II package and CTIS upload check
applies_to: the Norway package as a whole (plan-level checklist step)

items.check: K1 recruitment and informed consent procedure present (EU v2.0 or equivalent content), with a section for every population pathway in the plan.
K2 recruitment material present in final Norwegian versions for every identification or recruitment tool.

Standard Norwegian PIS and ICF present, and one L1 set per population and population set whose trigger is true (guardian and age-band documents, representative and adapted participant documents, emergency set with the right-to-object letter, witness, pregnancy, broad consent).
For every Norwegian site: M1 CV and M2 declaration of interests for the principal investigator, and N1 site suitability form issued by a non-PI institutional representative.
O1 certificate from the Norwegian Medicines Liability Association present, with the statement on additional trial-specific insurance.
P1 compensation and reimbursement description and P2 financing and site-arrangements description present.
R1 GDPR compliance statement present.
S1 biological-samples compliance document present.
items.applies_when: samples.collected or samples.archive_used or samples.import or samples.export

items.check: General biobank's REK-approved consent present.
Items outside Part II are routed correctly: proof of fee payment and the Norwegian protocol synopsis in Part I; patient cards, thank-you cards and staff interview guides not submitted.
Consent forms and recruitment materials are in Norwegian.
All other Part II attachments are in English.
No participant, representative or investigator signature on any blank K or L document; no signature added to M1, M2, N1, P1, P2, R1 or S1; O1 as issued.
Foreign-language translations are not uploaded; where used, the sponsor's accuracy evidence is recorded as a source.
Compensation amounts and conditions identical in P1 and every participant document.
Injury coverage (LAF certificate, any additional insurance) identical in O1 and every participant document.
Sample types, biobank, storage, transfers, destruction or return identical in S1, the protocol and the participant documents.
End of trial, end of research activity and data deletion year identical across all participant documents and consistent with the protocol; deletion at least 25 years after the end of the trial.
Consent pathways and consent-taker rules in K1 match the L1 sets in the package.
Planned enrolment by site in N1 (or the enrolment plan) matches CTIS.
Documents adapted from the reference package contain all Norwegian additions (dates, biobank, LAF/NPE, consent-taker rule) and no leftovers from the reference country.
items.applies_when: Norway is not the reference package

items.check: Correct B-S section prefix and CTIS category for each document.
Unique, self-explanatory title of at most 100 characters: <section code>_<document type>_<subtype>_<country>_<language>_<special attribute>, with only the fields that distinguish the document.
Version numbers and dates in CTIS structured fields match the uploaded documents; not in the title.
Personal names only where disclosure permits (principal investigator in M1/M2).
Clean, tracked-change, redacted or public and split-file variants clearly distinguished.
Searchable, copyable files, preferably PDF rather than scanned images; filename base contains none of ( ) / , . ; | [ ].
RFI response: revised documents uploaded to the dossier as clean and tracked-change versions, not only attached to the response.
Article 11 workaround: every mandatory Part II placeholder holds the official placeholder PDF titled Part_II_placeholder_document_Article_11_workaround.
items.applies_when: Norway receives Part I only under Article 11

items.check: For each document, publication status checked against the current Annex I publication tables (revised CTIS transparency rules; ACT EU guidance v2.2, 30 April 2026).
Where publication rules apply: a complete version marked not for publication and a properly redacted version marked for publication.
Names, signatures and other personal data (including witness data) removed from public versions.
No personal data or CCI in public structured fields.
No drafting instruction remains in any document (see content/conventions/template-instructions.md).
Every document approved by the owner in TrialAgents, or the user has explicitly chosen to export unapproved versions.
